book.name: Mateo
book.title: Hen anchi ammayay chamagway ensorat Mateo

content: Hen namachasan Chumunyu an Jesus way fumasor
Angkay hiyachi yag enetnod hen Espiritun Apudyus ah Jesus hen anchi chanak ta ahchi hen mamachasan Chumunyu way mangawis an hiya.
Wat angkay ini-inggaw ahchi ah opatporoy ag-agaw way ammag iggay nangnangan, wat ammag hommenaang way térén.
Yag yachi way ammag amchan hen henaangna, émméy ah Chumunyu way i mangawis an hiya way mangaliyén, “No hea hen tot-oway anà Apudyus paat wat mamfaliném hen antoy fato ah aném.”
Yag senongfatan Jesus hiya way mangaliyén, “Nesosorat hen alen Apudyus way ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Achi ummat hen ma-an ah iyatagun hen tatagu, te masaporcha agé chillu hen aminay enalen Apudyus ah mataguwancha ah ing-inggana.’ ”

content: Angkay hiyachi yag inyéy Chumunyu hiya ad Jerusalem way i nangempatùchu hen tabfongan hen anchi faréy Apudyus way ekatchéén Templo.
Yag annaat agé ifaga an hiya way mangaliyén, “No tot-owa way anàcha-a an Apudyusat mampêchag-a udpay, te nesosorat met hen anchi alena way ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Ifagan Apudyus hen anchichay anghelna ta halimunancha-a wat ancha-ag hèmatén way ammag uray hen he-emat achi mepetag hen anchi fato.’ ”

content: Yag sommongfat agé ah Jesus way mangaliyén, “Oo a, ngém wacha chillu hen nesosorat way alen Apudyus way ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Achiyu cha padpachasén hen kafaelan Apudyus way Apoyu.’ ”

content: Angkay hiyachi way narpas agéchi, inyéy Chumunyu hiya hen ammag akayyang way filig, yag empàilana hen aminay namfinafinab-én way toray hen antoy lota ya hen kaenammaycha.
Yag annaat ifaga way mangaliyén, “Idchat-o aminto an hea no an-a mampalentomang way manayaw an haén.”
Yag senongfatan Jesus way mangaliyén, “Lomayaw-aat Chumunyu te hen nesosorat chillu hen alen Apudyus way ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Ammag maid kasen chayawényu no faén yanggay hen apoyu way ah Apudyus, ya maid agé kasen afurotonyu no faén yanggay hiya.’ ”

content: Hiyachi yag lommayaw tot-owa ah Chumunyu, yag émméycha hen anchichay anghel way i manorong an Jesus.
Hen nanginlugiyan Jesus way mantudtuchu
Angkay hiyachi way chengngar Jesus way nifarud ah Juan way chan funfunyag, lommayaw way namfangad hen anchi provinsiyan hen Galilea.
Ngém iggay inggaw ad Nazaret te nanchakpos ad Capernaum way nehag-én hen anchi fayfay way ekatchéén Galilea way nan-apet hen sakopon hen Zabulon ya Neftali.
Yachi hen nekaman ah tommot-owaan hen enalen hen anchi profeta way Isaias ad namenghan hen nangaryanéén,

content.text: “Matorongancha hen anchichay tatagu ad Zabulon yad Neftali way fafabréy hen chumang hen anchi wangwang way Jordan way nan-apet hen anchi fayfay way chicha hen anchichay faén Judio way ini-inggaw hen anchi provinsiyan hen Galilea.

Hen cha nadchiy tatagu, kamancha ini-inggaw hen helang te ammag nahehellangan hen hamhamàcha gapon fasorcha, yag yachi agé hen nesenaancha an Apudyus. Ngém ammay ad uwan te cha mahelawan hen hamhamàcha te inumchah hen anchi napegsay Helaw an chicha.”

content: Yag nanepod hen hiyachi, inlugin Jesus way manginwarawag hen itudtuchuna, ekatnéén, “Masapor etagayyu hen annay laweng way a-ammayu te tég-angay hen milugiyan hen mantorayan Apudyus an chàyu.”
Hen nangayagan Jesus hen anchichay mangagadchiw ah mampasorotna
Angkay hiyachi way cha manaran ah Jesus hen penget hen anchi fayfay way Galilea, innilana hen chuway hen-agi way cha Simon way mamPedro yah Andres way chacha manafukor te mangagadchiwcha chillu.
Yachi yag imfagan Jesus an chicha way mangaliyén, “Ehàfayu chaha ta metnod-ayu an haén ta falewà hen hiyahay chunuyu ta hen tatagu hen atenglényu ah omafurotancha an haén.”
Wat enhàfacha tot-owa hen anchi tafukorcha yag netnodcha an Jesus.

Angkay nànàéycha yag innilan Jesus hen kasen hen-agi way cha Jaime an Juan way nìtutùchucha an amacha way Zebedeo hen anchi fangkacha way chacha taramanén hen tafukorcha. Yachi yag enayagan Jesus chicha agé.
Wat anchag tenaynan ah amacha ya hen anchi fangkacha way netnod an cha Jesus.
Hen nantudtuchuwan Jesus ya hen nanga-anana hen saket

Angkay hiyachi, cha émé-éméy ah Jesus hen kafabréfabréy hen provinsiyan hen Galilea way cha i mantudtutudtuchu hen anchichay chacha ma-am-amongan way Judio way ekatchéén sinagoga way yachi hen chana minwarawagan hen anchi ammayay chamag mepanggép hen mantorayan Apudyus. Ya chana agé etape way manga-an hen anchichay namfinafinab-én way saket ya ligat hen tatagu.

Yachi yag ammag nanhemamag hen mepanggép an hiya hen aminay fabréy hen anchi lota ad Siria, wat hen anchichay tatagu, inyéycha an hiya amin hen anchichay chan saket way namfinafinab-én hen ligatcha, te wachacha hen anchichay nahurugan ya hen chan orchah ya umat agé hen anchichay napàroy hen acharna. Yag cha natto way ligatat ammag kena-an Jesus amin.

Wat hiyachi, chuarcha hen anchichay tatagu way cha umunu-unud an hiya way narpon provinsiyan hen Galilea ya Judea ya anat ad Decapolis ya ad Jerusalem ya umat agé hen anchichay fabréy way chumang hen anchi wangwang way Jordan.
